note: TEST VECTORS ONLY. The key below is derived from a published seed and signs nothing real. Regenerate with tests/contract/generate-vectors.php.

cases.name: company_wide_member_verified_by_product
cases.why: A company-wide subscription qualifies a current member the product has verified.

cases.name: company_wide_no_membership_evidence
cases.why: The company is paid but nothing says this user belongs to it: not paid.

cases.name: company_wide_user_removed_per_product
cases.why: The product knows the user is no longer a member.

cases.name: company_wide_member_document
cases.why: The backend states current membership in a member-level document.

cases.name: member_document_not_a_member
cases.why: The backend states the user is not (or no longer) a member.

cases.name: company_level_question_without_user
cases.why: A company-level question (e.g. a Remote session accounted to its company) is answered by a company-wide licence.

cases.name: seat_assigned
cases.why: Individually assigned seat: the holder is paid.

cases.name: seat_unassigned
cases.why: A member of a seat-licensed company without a seat.

cases.name: seat_revoked
cases.why: A seat that has been revoked.

cases.name: seat_licence_company_document_only
cases.why: A seat licence cannot be satisfied by the company document and a membership claim.

cases.name: seat_licence_question_without_user
cases.why: A seat licence needs a user.

cases.name: seat_revoked_by_feed
cases.why: The changes feed revoked this (company, user) pair at the document's revision.

cases.name: seat_revocation_of_another_user
cases.why: Revoking another user's seat does not touch this one.

cases.name: company_lapse_beats_seat_document
cases.why: The company licence is suspended; a seat document that has not caught up does not help.

cases.name: switching_company_no_entitlement
cases.why: The same user in company B, which has no licence for them: nothing carries over from A.

cases.name: switching_company_expired
cases.why: The same user in company B whose subscription has expired.

cases.name: misfiled_member_document
cases.why: A genuine paid member document of company A filed under company B.

cases.name: misfiled_company_document
cases.why: A genuine paid company document of A filed under B.

cases.name: member_document_of_another_user
cases.why: u1's member document filed under u9.

cases.name: wrong_product
cases.why: A genuine paid document for another product.

cases.name: personal_licence_in_personal_context
cases.why: A personal, user-scoped licence applies in a personal context.

cases.name: personal_licence_not_carried_into_a_company
cases.why: It is not carried into a company context where the company has no licence for the user.

cases.name: company_licence_is_not_personal
cases.why: A company licence does not make a personal context paid.

cases.name: personal_context_without_user
cases.why: No company and no user: nothing to evaluate.

cases.name: free_plan
cases.why: The company is on a free plan.

cases.name: state_expired
cases.why: The backend states the licence has expired.

cases.name: valid_until_passed
cases.why: State still says paid but valid_until has passed by the time of use.

cases.name: state_suspended
cases.why: The backend states the licence is suspended.

cases.name: state_unknown
cases.why: The backend itself does not know.

cases.name: stale_document
cases.why: Issued more than the maximum age (48 h) before use.

cases.name: issued_in_future
cases.why: Issued after "now" by more than the clock-skew allowance.

cases.name: not_yet_valid
cases.why: valid_from is in the future.

cases.name: trial_is_not_paid_capacity
cases.why: A paid-state trial: the default policy admits kind "paid" only.

cases.name: company_revoked
cases.why: A revocation of the company document at its revision.

cases.name: company_revocation_of_older_revision
cases.why: A revocation of an OLDER revision does not affect a newer document.

cases.name: tampered_field
cases.why: A field edited after signing.

cases.name: unsigned
cases.why: No signature at all.

cases.name: signed_by_another_key
cases.why: Signed by a key the product does not hold, under a known key id.

cases.name: unknown_key_id
cases.why: Signed correctly but under a key id the product does not hold.

cases.name: malformed_paid_without_licence
cases.why: State paid but no licence_id: refused as malformed.

cases.name: malformed_member_claim_on_company_document
cases.why: A company-level document that claims a membership: refused as malformed.
